text:
maria: Heads-up — getting repeated GPU_Pool_Saturation alerts for eu-west pools but Grafana shows low sustained utilization. Feels noisy.

 tom: Which alert exactly? any alertmanager payload?

 maria: Alert name: GPU_Pool_Saturation (firing). Alertmanager link: https://alertmanager.redwood.example/alerts/1234 and Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/queue-panels?orgId=1&panelId=22

 lia: We've seen similar before when short-lived queue spikes cross quantile thresholds. Could be micro-bursts or tiny-batches causing transient queue depth.

 akeem: Pasting the PromQL I used for the panel:
```
sum by(pool) (rate(queue_depth{region=\"eu-west\"}[2m])) / sum by(pool) (capacity_gpu{pool=~\".*\"})
```

 tom: That one is noisy because it's an instantaneous-ish rate. Try smoothing with avg_over_time or using `sum_over_time` and a longer window, e.g. 5m. Also consider dividing by `max_over_time(capacity_gpu[10m])` if provisioning bounces.

 maria: Found a short scheduler log snippet at 2025-09-18T15:02:03Z: "enqueue 12 requests; batch_target=128; actual_batch=16; flush_reason=timeout(20ms)" — micro-burst then immediate flush.

 lia: Yeah that explains it. A tiny batch flush produces a queue spike read by the probe, fires the alert, then drops. Alert flaps.

 infra-bot: GPU_Pool_Saturation for eu-west-gpu-pool resolved (was firing 3x in 5m).

 akeem: Proposal: update alert query to use `avg_over_time(queue_depth[5m])` and require `for: 10m` in Alertmanager. Also add a companion metric `count_over_time(small_batch_events[10m])` to track tiny-batch frequency.

 tom: Also add a Grafana transform: moving_average(5m) on the queue_depth panel to reduce visual churn. For paging, use a separate high-sensitivity alert if small-batch count spikes above threshold.

 maria: Cost impact note — tiny batches increase per-token GPU time and memory pressure; preliminary calc shows ~+7% unit cost on affected pools during bursts. We should include that in the PR description.

 lia: I'll open a PR to change the alert and add the small-batch counter panel. Will include PromQL and Alertmanager snippet.

 maria: Thanks — assigning to @lia. :thumbsup:

 tom: Quick check: also correlate with network jitter. When egress jitter spikes we see retries & shrunk batching. Net probe shows packet loss around the same timestamps.

 akeem: Good call — I'll correlate net-probe:egress_error_rate and scheduler tiny-batch events and add a dashboard row.

 maria: Let's monitor for a week after the changes and re-evaluate thresholds. If noise persists we can try a percentile-based threshold (p95 queue_depth) instead.

 lia: Will do. I'll add an annotation in Grafana for the alert rule change timestamp so we can spot before/after behaviour.

 tom: Fine-grained follow-ups:
- increase alert evaluation_interval from 1m -> 2m to reduce churn on noisier queries
- add `for: 10m` in the firing rule
- add `small_batch_events` counter and panel

 maria: Perfect. Thanks everyone.

 lia: PR incoming in ~30m.

 infra-bot: Automated note: deploy pipeline for alert-rule change scheduled at 2025-09-19T09:00:00Z.
